🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: very low sector breadth (only Energy and Utilities positive) and broad weakness across Tech, Healthcare and Financials; leadership concentrated in cyclicals (Energy/Materials/Utilities) while megacap Tech sits BELOW TREND — mixed signals support NEUTRAL.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities showing short-term bounce: VST (1W: +6.89% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +4.83%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary weak: SBUX (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -4.35%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: AMGN (1W: -6.93% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND. Technology weak: ADBE (1W: -10.12% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +6.89% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY, COP (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +4.83%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5: Energy/Utilities/Materials). Style: Value/Cyclical favored.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMGN (1W: -6.93% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, EMR (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -12.74%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -7.85%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Healthcare, Industrials and select Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +6.89% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY, COP (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence across majors (JPM, GOOGL, AMZN show 1W ≠ 1M) — treat moves tactical and watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech under pressure with concentrated losers; AAPL (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +1.95%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -2.51% — weakness dominates and recent bullish headlines for NVDA have not yet translated to price confirmation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials muddy: JPM (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -6.31%) RECOVERY while Visa MA (V (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: -1.66% and broadly negative; watch for earnings/credit signals to re-define leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is lagging: JNJ (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -1.97%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -3.10% and headlines for JNJ/MDT are not yet reversing price pressure.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals in Energy/Materials: XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech that are BELOW TREND: AAPL (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND. Monitor JPM (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -6.31%) RECOVERY and NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND for confirmation before re-risking.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND for energy continuation. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -10.12% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, EMR (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -12.74%) BELOW TREND for downside follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +11.70%) — primary leader; Utilities (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +1.15%) for defensive respite. BEARISH: Technology, Healthcare and Industrials (each negative on 1W) — watch for further distribution.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND — breach of this week’s lows would signal deeper pullback; AAPL (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim short-term resistance confirms trend; XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND — hold above recent 1M uptrend to validate rotation into Energy.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+60): Nvidia CEO optimism headline vs price NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price diverging (distribution risk). AMZN (+60): OpenAI stake headline vs AMZN (1W: -1.31% | 1M: +4.34%) CORRECTION — positive news but 1W pullback, mixed confirmation. JNJ (+75): FDA nod headline vs JNJ (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -1.97%) BELOW TREND — positive catalyst not yet confirmed in price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (-70): legal/class action headline vs LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned (heightened downside risk). ADBE (-45): analyst cut vs ADBE (1W: -10.12% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND — price confirming negative news. SBUX (-60): downgrade vs SBUX (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND — confirms weakening momentum.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-cap Tech and conflicting news on LLY/NVDA — watch for trend breaks before adding directional exposure.
